column13: The e learning porta has been amazing

The Kenya School of Government (KSG) can improve its eLearning courses and participants' online learning experience by regularly updating course content to reflect current policies and best practices, making courses more interactive through quizzes, discussions, case studies, and live webinars, and ensuring the learning platform is user-friendly and accessible on mobile devices. KSG should also provide timely feedback on assessments, offer reliable technical support, and make learning materials and recorded sessions available for flexible access. Encouraging active facilitator engagement, promoting peer-to-peer collaboration, using practical assessments, and continuously collecting participant feedback will further enhance the quality of online learning, increase course completion rates, and improve the overall learning experience.
column14: The training programme was well organized, informative, and relevant to enhancing professional skills and competencies. To make future programmes even more effective, it would be beneficial to include more practical case studies, hands-on exercises, and interactive group discussions that relate directly to workplace challenges. Overall, the programme was valuable and has equipped participants with practical skills that can contribute to improved service delivery in their organizations.
